entities.summary: Gioacchino Volpe was an Italian historian and politician. He was General Secretary of the Royal Academy of Italy from 1929 to 1934 and member of the Accademia dei Lincei from 1935 to 1946. Between 1924 and 1940 he was professor of modern history at the Sapienza University of Rome.
